nodes.description: Monoamine excess during development alters maturation of monoaminergic circuits. In Maoa-null mouse pups, brain serotonin rises up to ninefold with cytoarchitectural changes in somatosensory cortex, and pup behavioural abnormalities are reversed by inhibiting serotonin synthesis, implying a developmental window. In humans this step is inferred from the model.

meta.association: Hemizygous loss-of-function variants in MAOA (Xp11.3) are the single cause of Brunner syndrome. ClinGen classifies the MAOA-Brunner syndrome relationship as Definitive with X-linked inheritance.

nodes.description: A hemizygous loss-of-function variant in MAOA (nonsense, frameshift, splice-site or inactivating missense) is the initiating germline lesion. Reported classes include the original exon-8 nonsense variant p.Gln296*, frameshift p.Ser251Lysfs*2, inactivating missense variants (p.Arg45Trp, p.Cys266Phe, p.Glu137Gly, p.Thr408Met), and a splice-site variant causing intron-8 retention and a premature stop codon.

In patient iPSC-derived dopaminergic neurons, MAOA loss reduces synaptic density yet produces hyperactive network activity driven by up-regulated GRIN2A/GRIN2B NMDA-receptor subunits; CRISPR correction of the MAOA variant normalises these features. This is a proximal synaptic mechanism demonstrated in vitro.

evidence.reference_title: Brunner syndrome associated MAOA mutations result in NMDAR hyperfunction and increased network activity in human dopaminergic neurons.
evidence.snippet: By correcting a MAOA missense mutation with CRISPR/Cas9 genome editing we normalized GRIN2A and GRIN2B expression, NMDAR function and neuronal population activity to control levels.

nodes.description: There is no approved disease-specific therapy and the evidence is case-level. Treatment with a serotonin reuptake inhibitor together with dietary modification reversed the biochemical abnormalities and improved 'serotonergic' symptoms and behaviour in one family, with a partial response in a carrier mother. The specific agent was not named in these reports. Use is cautious because raising synaptic serotonin in a disorder of serotonin excess is counterintuitive.
